violations.text: The presence of roaches and small flies is not controlled as evidenced by live roach and fly activity. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. PCS technician was on-site at the time of inspection and placed treatment for roaches. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026
Cases of tuna and vegetable oil were observed stored on the floor in the market area. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 06/22/2026
The glass door to the display case was observed in poor repair, held with duct tape. New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2026

Raw animal foods were not stored properly to prevent cross-contamination. Inspector observed raw eggs on same shelf as ready-to-eat foods (vegetables) in the self-service cooler. Except when combined as ingredients, different types of raw animal foods must be separated from each other during storage by using separate equipment or arranging each type of food in equipment so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented. New Violation. Correct By: 09/12/2024
Cases of raw chicken were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 09/12/2024

The deli display case located at the front counter area was not in good repair. Inspector observed ice accumulation at the condenser. PIC stated service has been scheduled. New Violation. Correct By: 09/26/2024
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine cover have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 09/26/2024
